problems.reason: Sentences 1 and 2 repeat the same size and weight information for Mantellisaurus.
Sentence 8 repeats the claim that Mantellisaurus was primarily bipedal.
Sentence 3 states the holotype was discovered in 1914, while later it says 1917.
Sentence 9 gives two different dates (2007 and 2006) for Gregory Paul establishing the genus.
Sentence 11 claims Mantellisaurus lived in the Early Cretaceous, then later says mid‑Cretaceous (~125 Ma), which is inconsistent.
Sentence 4 describes an Iguanodon specimen from 1834, not Mantellisaurus.
Sentence 6 discusses Dollodon bampingi, a different genus.
Sentence 12 discusses the validity of Dollodon, not Mantellisaurus.
